key_impacts: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats.
Parts of mangroves remained under water.
Properties in low-lying coastal areas were destroyed.
Few lives were lost after coast guards warned people away from beaches and low areas.
evidence_snippets: Safari visited Juma’s home in Amu… ‘was Amu affected and how?’
‘Within two hours, mountains of waves started to hit the coast… fishermen lost most of their fishing boats… mangroves are still under water… properties… destroyed.’
missing_information: Damage extent limited to qualitative descriptions.

key_impacts: No electricity for industries and homes.
Industries closed and many people lost jobs.
Community relied on food relief from government and well-wishers.
People lost most of their animals due to lack of drinking water.
evidence_snippets: “It sometimes continues for several years, like in 1999-2001.”
“There was also no electricity… industries were forced to close down and many people lost their jobs.”
“During that particular drought, we mainly survived on food relief from the government and other well wishers.”
missing_information: Affected settlement referenced as ‘our village’; interpreted as Amu Island from context.
